title: A busy stretch at Austin's airport
subtitle: Race-week travel and the start of a utility project
alt: Timeline from KXAN and CBS Austin: on October 19 Austin-Bergstrom International Airport began a campus-wide utility project; its busiest travel days run Thursday, October 22, through Tuesday, October 27; Monday, October 26, the day after the Formula 1 race, is expected to be the single busiest day; the utility project is expected to be finished in 2029.
